description: This file defines the interface and implementation details for an IPC server in the Rialto project, including classes for server creation, client management, socket handling, and message processing.
external_methods: bool addSocket(const std::string &, std::function<void(const std::shared_ptr<IClient>&)>, std::function<void(const std::shared_ptr<IClient>&)>)

classes.name: ServerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IPC server instances.

classes.name: ServerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the IPC server handling socket connections, client management, and message processing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IServer instance.

methods.name: addSocket
methods.description: Adds a socket at the specified path and sets up connection callbacks.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Adds a client based on a socket file descriptor and sets up disconnection callback.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns the server's main socket file descriptor.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for events with a specified timeout.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event message to a specific client.

methods.name: isClientConnected
methods.description: Checks if a client is currently connected.

methods.name: disconnectClient
methods.description: Disconnects a client by its ID.
